Name: Decorated Coop and Barn
Author: VvVvVvV2222222222
Description:
The mod changes the Coops and Barns into a slightly cleaner and more decorated version of them. With each upgrade it gets a little more decorated. The walls cannot change colors unless you change the cooptiles.png added to this mod.

Just place it in your mods folder and it should work!

The pigs are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10]Better Pigs and Recolours[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5497250]Zhuria[/url]

CREDITS extra deco:
I used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34984615]Eemee[/url]'s flowers, but I added pots to them.

Downloads.Description: Just drop it in the mods folder and it should work!
